claims.text: The trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier TRP-00107 and describe one journey: the trace's first fix at 2026-07-18T21:13:42+08:00 sits two seconds after the trip_record's started_at of 2026-07-18T21:13:40+08:00, and the fare_breakdown is billed against the same trip. The same-trip condition in POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied.

The governing measurement under POL-RD-01 is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, 17.57 km, not the rounded trip_record copy of 17.6 km. Against the platform optimal of 14.0 km that is an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5%, which clears both establishment limbs of POL-RD-01: greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute. The deviation is established.

The gps_trace is tagged IMPAIRED at weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED - a 331.8 m multipath jump between 21:44:52 and 21:45:02 on the final approach in the Raffles Place urban canyon, implying an impossible 193.6 kph in and 238.9 kph out. I disclose that impairment. It does not disable the trace, because POL-RD-07's own policy thresholds are not met: the gaps list is empty with max_gap_sec 0.0 (no gap over 90 s), the jump is 331.8 m, under the 500 m limb, and the sampling interval is a steady 10 s, under the 30 s limb. A deviation may still be established on this trace.

Because rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 5 while deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is only 1, and the excess here is 25.5% - below 30% - POL-RD-08 requires corroboration of the claim beyond the gps_trace. That corroboration is on the record: the driver's own counterparty statement admits the route the trace measured, 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it', a corridor the optimal route does not use, the routing engine recording the optimal as CTE southbound throughout; his in-app reply of the same night offers only a traffic excuse and does not dispute the off-CTE line taken.

No traffic-advisory exoneration is available. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses; the only such artifact in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00107-01, is MISSING - no payload, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so limb (a) cannot be met and no advisory covers the CTE on the evening of 18 July 2026. The driver's bare assertion that the CTE was jammed cites no advisory ID and, under POL-RD-08, does not discharge his burden.

The driver's justification that the detour 'was faster for the passenger' is contradicted by the trip_record's own clock: the trip ran 34.0 minutes against a platform optimal of 24.0 minutes, so the off-optimal route cost the rider about ten minutes on top of the 3.57 km of extra distance, on a Saturday-night surge fare of 1.35x. The record shows a slower, longer trip, not a mitigation.

POL-RD-04 does not bear on this trip. The chat log holds exactly two messages - the rider asking 'why exit at whitley?' and the driver answering 'cte very jam tonight boss' - neither of which is a rider instruction identifying a place or road, and waypoint_hint is null on both. No rider-requested detour is recorded, so no excess is excluded on that footing.

POL-RD-05 does not apply either: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so the optimal is not re-based and the booked 14.0 km figure stands as the baseline.

POL-RD-12 does not apply: vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so the matched-itinerary baseline question never arises and the whole measured excess counts against the driver under POL-RD-01.

With the deviation established and no exculpatory clause left standing, POL-RD-02 fixes the money. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = (21.02 x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177. Refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and only 20.3% of the charged total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 7.45, not a full refund.

Nothing falls to be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and no separate pass-through correction arises: the fare_breakdown's erp_gantries list is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00, so there is no off-route ERP line to refund, no phantom gantry and no surcharge to correct under POL-RD-09.

claims.text: The excess the rider needs is measured by one artifact only, EV-GPS-00107, and that artifact is impaired: the pre-pass tags it GPS_DRIFT — a 331.8 m multipath jump between the fixes at 21:44:52, 21:44:57 and 21:45:02 in the Raffles Place urban canyon, with reported accuracy degrading to 42 m on the outlier — and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, 193.6 kph into and 238.9 kph out of the same outlier. I disclose that impairment; weight 0.30. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measurement and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, so no second artifact carries the excess: the 3.57 km figure stands or falls on a trace at weight 0.30. Under POL-GEN-02 a deciding fact carried by a single artifact at that weight caps confidence below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-RD-10(1) makes that a mandatory escalation, in which the disputed amount is held and no refund issues.

The only candidate second carrier is the billed distance on EV-FARE-00107, distance_charged_km 17.60, and it is not independent of the trace. It repeats the trace figure of 17.57 km copied through the trip record as actual_distance_km 17.6, which POL-RD-01 characterises as a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement, and POL-RD-07 directs the Judge to check whether a billed distance is a copy of the trace figure before treating it as corroboration. A figure re-published from the same impaired measurement (EV-GPS-00107, weight 0.30, GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED) confirms nothing and cannot lift the confidence cap off 0.30.

The driver's account is that the CTE into town was jammed near Chin Swee and that he went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it — his message at 21:26:48 on EV-CHAT-00107. POL-RD-03 is the clause that would exonerate that route, but the artifact the clause requires does not exist: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, no payload, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING), because no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE that evening. Limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-03 cannot be run at all on this record, and POL-RD-10(5) names this precise situation — a closure asserted with no traffic_advisory — as a mandatory escalation, which holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it.

However the trace question is resolved, the deviation is not MATERIAL and no uplift is available against the driver. The excess is 3.57 km against the 8.0 km limb and 25.5% against the 50% limb of POL-RD-01, so POL-RD-06's profile check is not engaged and the FULL_REFUND route in POL-RD-06(b) is closed. The citable counters confirm the absence of any pattern: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 and completed_trips_90d is 619, far below both the 3-or-more test and the 0.05-ratio-with-40-trips test in POL-RD-06, and POL-GEN-01 confines that artifact to those two fields only. (The trace behind the excess is impaired at 0.30 for GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, as disclosed.)

The rider carries the initial burden under POL-RD-08, and on her own profile it is heavier than usual: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 5 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1, so a claim with an excess below 30% — this one is 25.5% — additionally requires corroboration beyond the gps_trace, drawn from the POL-RD-07(ii) list. The pool gives her no measurement of the route: erp_gantries on EV-FARE-00107 is empty, so no charge line places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, and the trace she relies on is itself impaired (EV-GPS-00107, weight 0.30, GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED). She should be put to strict proof of an independent source.

Nothing is due on the pass-through lines and nothing can be added on top of the distance-and-time arithmetic. erp_gantries is empty, the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are both 0.00, and there is no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no promo discount to unwind, so POL-RD-09 produces no standalone correction and no billing-integrity finding on this fare. The rider's entire recovery is therefore bounded by the POL-RD-02 computation on a charged_total of 36.60, whatever larger figure she advances in her claim.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this route-deviation claim cannot be finally decided on the present record, so it goes to a human reviewer and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded. Here is why, and what would settle it.

First, what the record does show. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00107) measures 17.57 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a platform optimal of 14.0 km — an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5%, clearing both limbs of POL-RD-01 (over 20% and over 0.8 km). The driver's own account, "I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it," concedes he left the CTE corridor the optimal route uses. So a deviation is made out, and the driver's traffic explanation does not exonerate it: POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming a road the optimal route uses, and the only such artifact, EV-ADVIS-00107-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no advisory was issued for the CTE that evening. POL-RD-08 also puts the driver to a specific artifact, which a bare "traffic was bad" cannot supply.

Second, why no money can issue. The excess the ruling would rest on is measured by one artifact only, the GPS trace, and that artifact is down-weighted to 0.30. The admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-GPS-00107 IMPAIRED with codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED — a 331.8 m multipath jump between 21:44:52 and 21:45:02 on the final approach into Raffles Place, implying an impossible speed. Two separate things must be said about it: it is down-weighted for confidence to 0.30, but it is NOT impaired for policy under POL-RD-07 — there is no gap over 90 s (max gap 0.0 s), the 331.8 m jump is under the 500 m limb, and sampling is a steady 10 s, under the 30 s limb — so a deviation may still be established on it, and it is. The obstacle is weight, not usability. The trip record's actual_distance_km (17.6) and the fare breakdown's distance_charged_km (17.60) are not independent of the trace: POL-RD-01 calls the trip-record figure a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement, and POL-RD-07(ii) directs me to check whether a billed distance is such a copy — it is. The driver's admission corroborates the route and satisfies the extra corroboration the rider's profile requires under POL-RD-08 (5 claims in 60 days, 1 substantiated), but as a statement in case.dispute with no weight_multiplier it enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence cap. The cap is therefore the minimum weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding fact — 0.30 — and the bundle mean of about 0.76 is context only, not the cap. 0.30 is below the platform-wide floor of 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) makes the escalation mandatory. A second trigger also fires: POL-RD-10(5), because an exculpatory clause (POL-RD-03) was invoked against an artifact that is missing from the pool.

On the remaining points: POL-RD-06 is not engaged — the deviation is not MATERIAL and the citable counters (deviation_flags_90d 1, completed_trips_90d 619) show no pattern — so no full refund and no driver-conduct referral arise. POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 do not apply (no rider instruction, no endpoint amendment, vehicle_type RYDE_X). Nothing is due on the pass-through lines under POL-RD-09: erp_gantries is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00, with no surcharge to correct. For completeness only, had confidence permitted a money ruling, POL-RD-02 would give recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177; refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45 — a PARTIAL_REFUND. That is not paid here, because escalation replaces the ruling.

What would resolve it: an independent measurement of the trip's actual distance that is not a copy of this trace (for example a platform-derived distance from a second source, or a trace reacquired clear of the multipath outlier), and/or a traffic_advisory covering the CTE for the evening of 18 July 2026, which would let POL-RD-03 be run.

ruling.explanation:
Trip TRP-00107, Ang Mo Kio to One Raffles Place, 18 July 2026. The rider's claim that the driver left the CTE corridor is upheld in part.

The money, on separate lines under POL-RD-02:
- charged_total: SGD 36.60
- recomputed_fare (optimal CTE route): ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = (21.02 x 1.35) + 0.80 = SGD 29.177
- refund: 36.60 - 29.177 = SGD 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45.

Deviation. The governing distance is the trace figure of 17.57 km against the platform optimal of 14.0 km: an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5%. Both POL-RD-01 limbs are met (>20% and >0.8 km), so the deviation is established. It is not MATERIAL (3.57 km < 8.0 km; 25.5% < 50%), so POL-RD-06's profile check is not engaged, and the driver's counters would show no pattern anyway (deviation_flags_90d 1 against completed_trips_90d 619). The refund is 20.3% of the charged total, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and well short of the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a partial refund.

The trace's weight. EV-GPS-00107 is down-weighted to 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath jump on the final Raffles Place approach, implying impossible speeds). I disclose that and apply POL-GEN-02: this is schema-level impairment only. Under POL-RD-07 the trace is NOT impaired for policy - the gaps list is empty with max_gap_sec 0.0, the jump is under the 500 m limb, and sampling is a steady 10 s, under the 30 s limb - so it remains usable and the finding survives the discount.

Why this is not an escalation (driver's POL-RD-10(1) and POL-RD-10(5) arguments). On (1): the excess is not carried by the trace alone. The driver's own admission carries the deviation independently - his counterparty statement concedes 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it', a corridor the optimal CTE route does not use, and his in-app message at 21:26:48 ('cte very jam tonight boss') concedes the same while the trip was running. The chat log EV-CHAT-00107 (weight 1.0) is a contemporaneous record made from inside the disputed window. Applying the removal test, the admission would still establish the deviation if the trace were removed, so it is a genuine independent carrier, not a restatement. The cap is therefore the MAXIMUM of the independent carriers' weights - max(0.30, 1.0) = 1.0 - and confidence of 0.85 sits above the 0.70 floor. This also supplies the corroboration POL-RD-08 requires (rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d 5 against deviation_claims_60d_substantiated 1, excess below 30%), drawn from the POL-RD-07(ii) list. The driver's point that the billed distance on EV-FARE-00107 (17.60 km) is a copy of the trace figure is correct and I do not rely on it; the admission carries the corroboration instead. To both parties. I cannot settle this one on the money; it must go to a human reviewer, and the disputed SGD 12.00 is held, not collected or refunded. Here is the reasoning.

THE ROUTE. I accept that the driver left the CTE and went by Newton and Kim Seng, as he himself says. The GPS trace measures 17.57 km against a platform-optimal 14.0 km, an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5%, which clears both limbs of POL-RD-01 (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km). The route deviation is therefore established on this record, and no rider instruction (POL-RD-04), no relocation (POL-RD-05), no pooled-itinerary question (POL-RD-12, the vehicle is RYDE_X) and no upfront-quote point (the fare model is METERED) changes that.

THE TRACE — BOTH THINGS I MUST SAY. EV-GPS-00107 is down-weighted to 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED: a 331.8 m multipath jump at 21:44:57 on the final approach in the Raffles Place urban canyon, implying an impossible 193.6 kph in and 238.9 kph out. First, it is NOT impaired for policy purposes: there is no gap over 90 s (max_gap_sec 0.0), no jump over 500 m (331.8 m), and the sampling interval is a steady 10 s. So the deviation may be, and is, established on it. Second, it is down-weighted in my confidence under POL-GEN-02.

NO EXONERATION. The driver's explanation that the CTE was jammed is unsupported. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic advisory; the only one minted, EV-ADVIS-00107-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the clause cannot be run and nothing exonerates the deviation. The driver's bare assertion cites no evidence and carries no weight under POL-RD-08. POL-RD-04 does not apply either: the chat log holds no rider instruction identifying any place or road, and waypoint_hint is null on both messages.

THE MONEY THAT WOULD FOLLOW. Under POL-RD-02 the refund would be charged_total 36.60 less recomputed_fare 29.177 = 7.423, rounded UP to SGD 7.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and only 20.3% of the charge, so it would be a PARTIAL_REFUND, not a full refund. Nothing is added on top: the erp_gantries list is empty and tolls_erp is 0.00, so POL-RD-09 produces no separate pass-through correction and no billing-integrity finding.

WHY I CANNOT ISSUE IT — THE TRIGGER I NAME. The fact this case turns on, the excess distance, is carried by one artifact only: the GPS trace, at weight 0.30. The trip record's 17.6 km and the fare breakdown's 17.60 km billed distance are rounded copies of the same trace measurement (POL-RD-01 says so of the trip record; POL-RD-07 directs me to check the billed figure, and it is a copy), so they are one carrier, not two. The driver's own statement and the in-app messages are real evidence about the route — the statement admits the Newton / Kim Seng line, and meets the POL-RD-08 corroboration requirement that the rider's serial-claimant counters (5 claims, 1 substantiated) impose — but they do not measure the distance and so cannot carry the excess. Under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence is therefore capped at 0.30, below the 0.70 floor this policy sets, and POL-RD-10(1) makes an escalation mandatory. That is the trigger: confidence below the platform floor, driven by the sole carrier at 0.30.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. An independent measurement of the actual distance at full weight — a clean trace free of the drift, or a billed distance the platform derived independently of the trace — would lift the cap and allow the SGD 7.45 (or such other figure as the clean record yields) to be paid.

REFERRALS. None fires. The deviation is not MATERIAL (3.57 km is under the 8.0 km limb and 25.5% under the 50% limb), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and there is no driver-conduct referral; the driver's citable counters (1 deviation flag in 90 days against 619 trips) show no pattern. There is no phantom gantry or wrongly applied surcharge, so POL-RD-09(4) does not fire, and no no-show element, so POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07 do not. POL-GEN-01 confines both profiles to credibility weighting only.

So: the deviation is established and the arithmetic would give the rider SGD 7.45, but the only artifact that measures the distance is down-weighted to 0.30, and the policy does not let me rule below the floor. The reviewer holds the disputed SGD 12.00 pending an independent distance measurement.

The pool gives her no measurement of the route: erp_gantries on EV-FARE-00107 is empty, so no charge line places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, and the trace she relies on is itself impaired (EV-GPS-00107, weight 0.30, GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED). She should be put to strict proof of an independent source.

Nothing is due on the pass-through lines and nothing can be added on top of the distance-and-time arithmetic. erp_gantries is empty, the on-optimal-route and off-optimal-route ERP totals are both 0.00, and there is no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no promo discount to unwind, so POL-RD-09 produces no standalone correction and no billing-integrity finding on this fare. The rider's entire recovery is therefore bounded by the POL-RD-02 computation on a charged_total of 36.60, whatever larger figure she advances in her claim.
